question: Which bīja sequences correspond to the ten-syllabled and sixteen-syllabled mantras named here?
premises: A ten-syllabled mantra is associated with śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ
The sixteen-syllabled mantra is associated with klīṃ-hrīṃ-śrīṃ
inference: The text pairs śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ with a ten-syllabled mantra and klīṃ-hrīṃ-śrīṃ with a sixteen-syllabled mantra.
plain_english: There is the ten-syllabled mantra with śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ, and the sixteen-syllabled mantra with klīṃ-hrīṃ-śrīṃ.
